$about: The HighRise component registry. One entry per component in code. 'status' is the audit against Figma: matches · matches-with-open-questions · partial · from-prototype (not in Figma yet). Every gap is written so a designer can act on it. Button gaps are generated by scripts/build-button.mjs into button.audit.json.

components.name: Button
components.coverage: All 8 sizes × 5 variants × 5 themes × 5 states, icon-only, loading, link-as-anchor.

components.name: Checkbox
components.coverage: 6 sizes, checked / unchecked / indeterminate, hover, focus, disabled, error, label + hint.

gaps.summary: The State property is spelled 'Disbaled' in Figma. Rename to 'Disabled' so code-connect and search match.
Disabled checkmark is 11×8 at md, enabled checkmark is 9×7. Pick one size. Code uses one checkmark for both.
Hovering an unchecked box fills it blue/100. That is a strong signal for a hover; confirm it is intended (most systems use gray/50).
Checked + error keeps the blue fill and only turns the border red. Code matches; flagging because the error is easy to miss.

components.name: Radio
components.coverage: 6 sizes, checked / unchecked, hover, focus, disabled, error, label + hint.

gaps.summary: Same 'Disbaled' spelling as Checkbox.
xs and 2xs both use a 5px inner dot although the circles are 14 and 12px. Code matches Figma.

components.name: Toggle
components.coverage: sm / md / lg, on / off, hover, focus, disabled, error, label + hint.

gaps.summary: Disabled-on and disabled-off look identical (both gray/100 track, gray/50 knob), so a disabled toggle never shows its value. Suggest a blue/200 track for disabled-on.
Focused-off lightens the track to gray/50, lighter than its resting gray/100. Focus usually darkens or keeps the track.
A second set 'Toggle Switch' (29443:110032, 48 variants) wraps this with label and hint. Code covers it through the label/hint props.

components.name: Tag
components.coverage: 13 colours × 4 sizes × filled / outline × square / rounded; hover, active, focus when interactive; dot, leading icon, removable.

gaps.summary: Gray tag: hover background equals default (both gray/100), only the border changes. Other colours step 50 → 100.
Pink tag: active background is pink/100, every other colour uses 200 for active.
lg uses the same 13/18 text as md; only height changes (28 vs 24). Confirm lg should not step to 14/20.
Rounded tags use a larger icon (18px) than square tags (14px) at md. Code uses the size prop only; confirm whether the rounded icon size is deliberate.

components.name: Tooltip
components.coverage: 7 themes, 4 placements, title + text, arrow. Hover and keyboard focus.

gaps.summary: Arrow 'Start' and 'End' positions (Figma Arrow Position) are not built yet; code centres the arrow.
Figma has an optional leading icon in the title row. Not built yet.

components.name: Input Field
components.coverage: 6 sizes; default, icon leading, prefix, suffix, password; hover, focus, disabled, error, filled. Label, hint and error message.

gaps.summary: 3xs (24px), 2xs (28px) and xs (32px) all use 14/20 text. In a 24px box that leaves 2px above and below. Suggest 12/17 at 3xs and 13/18 at 2xs.
3xs focused border is blue/600; every other size uses blue/300 when focused.
Hover drops the xs shadow; focus brings it back. Confirm the shadow should disappear on hover.
Not built yet: Date picker, Time picker, Payment input, Tags, Phone number, Leading/trailing dropdown and Leading text types (9 of 14 types).
The label and hint are not part of this Figma set. Code takes their style from the Checkbox group row (14/20 Medium gray-700, 13/18 gray-500). Verify against the HighRise Label component.

components.name: Select
components.coverage: 6 sizes; default, placeholder, open, disabled, error; keyboard navigation and type-ahead.

gaps.summary: Select md has 14px side padding, Input Field md has 12px. They sit side by side in forms, so the text does not line up. Pick one.
The open menu is not in the Select set; code uses surface/overlay, Shadow/lg and 8px radius from the Dropdown Menu page. Audit against Dropdown Menu (18:0) next.
Not built yet: Icon leading, Search, Tags and Avatar leading types.

components.name: Alert
components.coverage: 6 colours, title, text, link actions, aside actions, dismiss.

gaps.summary: Alert uses 8px padding with a 12px corner radius, so the icon sits close to the curved corner. Most HighRise surfaces pair 12px radius with 12–16px padding.
Figma's Inline=True variant (one-line alert) is not built separately; a title-only alert covers it.

components.name: App shell & left nav
components.coverage: Account rail, main nav, section nav with nested items, badges and a New tag, collapsible section nav, sticky page bar, responsive (rail hides < 900px).

gaps.summary: The new left nav is not in the HighRise 1.1 file. Built from the FastPay prototype's Shared nav board and the left-nav prototype. Add it to Figma (Primary Navigation Toolbar 28471:86099 is the old top nav).

components.name: Card
components.coverage: Title, description, header actions, footer, three paddings, interactive.

gaps.summary: Card lives on the BACKLOG page in Figma, not in Components. Code uses the FastPay prototype values (gray/200 border, 12px radius). Promote a Card to the library.

components.name: Statistic
components.coverage: Label, value, toned note, negative value, link tile.

gaps.summary: Statistic is listed under Super Groups but has no published component set yet. Values come from the FastPay prototype KPI tiles.

components.name: Table
components.coverage: Header + body cells, hover, clickable rows (keyboard), selected row, custom cell slots, responsive column hiding, empty state.

gaps.summary: Header cells use a gray/300 bottom border while body rows in the FastPay prototype use gray/200. Figma cells share one Border property; confirm the header should be heavier.
Not built: sort and filter menus, column configurator, drag handles, striped rows, expandable rows (all in Figma).

components.name: Tabs
components.coverage: Line and segment types, primary and secondary themes, sm/md/lg, count badge, disabled, arrow-key navigation.

gaps.summary: Secondary Line active text is gray/700 while its underline is gray/900. Code matches Figma.

components.name: Modal & drawer
components.coverage: Centered modal and right-side drawer, title + description, footer left/right actions, focus trap, Esc, return focus.

gaps.summary: The Figma Side Panel (28471:97971) is a tab rail, not a detail drawer. The right drawer reuses the Modal tokens. Add a Drawer to Figma if it should differ.
Not built: Success / Info / Warning / Destructive header icons, mobile bottom sheet.

components.name: Pagination
components.coverage: md/sm, count text, previous/next, truncated page list, current page.

gaps.summary: The current page uses a blue/500 border. No other HighRise component uses blue/500 for a border (focus uses blue/300, hover blue/600).
Rows-per-page select and jump-to-page input are not built.
Only the 2xs variant was measured (11/16 · 10/15). sm and md text sizes follow the HighRise type ramp; check against Figma.
Illustration graphics (Graphic=True) are not exported yet.

components.name: Description list
components.coverage: Label/value rows, total row, monospace values, grid layout.

gaps.summary: No HighRise equivalent (Key Value Pair is in the backlog, 28041:45141).
No HighRise equivalent. Built from tokens for payment and dispute history.

semantic.source: HighRise 1.1 has no semantic layer. Each semantic role is mapped to the 1.1 primitive that 1.1 components use for it.
semantic.note: Proposal: add these as a Semantic collection in the 1.1 Figma file so design and code share the same names.

icons.note: HighRise uses Untitled UI icons. Code uses Lucide icons with matching stroke weight until the icon set is exported.
